primitives.query: UserProfiles[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Scope`,to_string(scope)]) , join(`: `, [`Network Config`,to_string(netgrp)]) , join(`: `, [`System Config`,to_string(sysgrp)]) , join(`: `, [`Security Profiles`,to_string(utmgrp)]), join(`: `, [`IPsec,SSL,PPTP,L2TP VPN`,to_string(vpngrp)])])
FirewallPolicy[].[name, srcintf[].name, dstintf[].name, srcaddr[].name, dstaddr[].name, service[].name, comments]

FirewallPolicy[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(name)]) , join(`: `, [`NAT`,to_string(nat)]), join(`: `, [`Action`,to_string(action)]), join(`: `, [`Status`,to_string(status)]), join(`: `, [`Source Address`,to_string(sort(srcaddr[].name))]), join(`: `, [`Source Interface`,to_string(sort(srcintf[].name))]), join(`: `, [`Service`,to_string(sort(service[].name))])])

FirewallVIP[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Type`, to_string(type)]), join(`: `, [`External IP`, to_string(extip)]), join(`: `, [`External Interface`, to_string(extintf)]), join(`: `, [`External Port`, to_string(extport)]), join(`: `, [`Mapped IP Range`, to_string(sort(mappedip[].range))]) , join(`: `, [`Mapped Port`, to_string(mappedport)])]) | sort(@)

primitives.fieldGotcha: Quoted key required in JMESPath because 'version' is a reserved word in some JMESPath implementations. Use Firmware.current."version" not Firmware.current.version. The id=521 metric provides an alternate path SystemInfo.Firmware.Version which may differ on some firmware versions.

primitives.query: Groups[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`,to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Email`,to_string(email)]), join(`: `, [`Member`,to_string(sort(member[].name))]), join(`: `, [`Group Type`,to_string("group-type")])]) | sort(@)

Interfaces[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Vdom`,to_string(vdom)]), join(`: `, [`Type`,to_string(type)]), join(`: `, [`IP & Subnet`,to_string(ip)]), join(`: `, [`Role`,to_string(role)]), join(`: `, [`VLAN ID`,to_string(vlanid)])]) | sort(@)

primitives.fieldGotcha: Two paths exist for model/version info. id=223 uses Firmware.current."platform-id" (the Fortinet API path). id=521 uses SystemInfo.Firmware.Version for the firmware string. These are complementary — use 223 for model, 224/521 for firmware version.

primitives.query: IPV4Routing[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Type`, to_string(type)]), join(`: `, [`Gateway`, to_string(gateway)]), join(`: `, [`IP Mask`, to_string(ip_mask)]), join(`: `, [`Interface`, to_string(interface)])]) | sort(@)

primitives.fieldGotcha: Users[] contains local VPN/firewall auth accounts only — NOT admin accounts. FortiGate admin accounts (System > Administrators) are NOT present in the dataprint. AdminUsers key returns null on all validated systems. Admin account audit requires manual FortiGate GUI review.
primitives.query: Users[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Vdom Name`,to_string(sort(vdom[].name))]), join(`: `, [`Type`,to_string(type_r)]), join(`: `, [`Profile`,to_string(accprofile)])]) | sort(@)
